blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – No Filipinos were harmed in the missile attacks in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said Monday morning. On Sept. 18 and 19, the Yemeni Houthi group launched drone and ballistic missile attacks targeting Riyadh and energy sites in Saudi Arabia. “The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) reported no Filipinos were affected following the explosions in Riyadh on Friday night and Saturday morning of September 18 and 19, after Houthi militants launched drone and ballistic missile attacks targeting the capital and energy sites along the Red Sea coasts,” the DMW said in a statement.
